reviews.title: Loved this, but what happened?
reviews.text:
Had the free version for many many years and loved it. 
I am a VERY lite user and maybe only used it a couple of times per year. I had things like my driving licence and birth certificate on. 
A few years ago both of my parents passed away (within 2 years of each other) and I used this to scan important documents. 
Just gone to use it now and the App has been removed (not by me). I have reinstalled it and all my documents have gone. 
I have tried to get back into the free version and it now only lasts 1 week with no guarantee I will get my important docs back. 
Now I understand that this was the free version and people should be happy to pay if they like an App but only using it a couple of times per year it is not good value for me. 
I think it’s upsetting for them to delete everything without pre warning so I could save my deceased parents documents that I will probably never easily get back.

reviews.title: Ultimate version defect
reviews.text: For iOS 15.8.7 for which the Ultimate version does download, the character recognition does not work. The very same OCR did function before in the mere Plus version, for which I have already paid for a life licence (including its full initial functionality). Reluctantly, understanding that maybe the developers need to make a living, and that their initial business plan was faulty, I agreed to subscribe to the Ultra version. (No lifetime licence for it.) But the OCR which functions flawlessly before in lower version, def doe not function here as it should. DO NOT SUBSCRIBE FOR THE TIME BEING! I will update this comment, as soon as this problem will have been resolved.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Tried to cancel my “free” subscription only to be told I do not have one, despite the fact I clearly do, and then had to play the anxious waiting game to see if they tried to bill me & fight for my money to be returned. Avoid if you can.
